title: Prompt cache hit rate fell to zero after the release; latency and cost up
scenario: After a release that moved tools to a feature-flag set and added the current time to every request, the assistant's prompt cache hit rate fell from 87% to 2%, time to first token tripled and the invoice tripled, while the internal cost dashboard stayed flat. The team blames the timestamp.
task: Compare request dumps and per-worker usage to find what changes in the cached prefix
Explain why a few requests still hit and whether the timestamp matters
Make the prefix byte-stable across processes; keep one breakpoint and dynamic data after it
Fix the cost formula so the dashboard matches the invoice
acceptance: Same prefix hash across worker processes with different PYTHONHASHSEED
Tools sorted, one breakpoint after the static system prompt
Cache writes and reads priced correctly
Root cause named with evidence; timestamp ruled out
